blocks.text: A value sequence can look correct even when equal-valued nodes were duplicated, skipped, or replaced. Tracing exact node identities exposes lost suffixes, repeated nodes, and accidental cycles. Sorting may hide order defects, variable names do not change behavior, and a sentinel cannot repair an unknown structural error by itself. After topology is verified, payload and ordering assertions can be layered on.

blocks.text: Identity traces make structural symptoms precise. A repeated object before null means the next relation has returned to an earlier node. If traversal terminates before required nodes appear, some incoming edge was overwritten or redirected past them. Payload repetition is legal, and node-count growth says nothing about sortedness; it may instead signal duplication or an attached foreign segment.
